item.title: Exclusive poll: GOP's gains among Latinos fade in House battlegrounds
item.description: Democrats have gained sharply with Latino voters in some of the country's most competitive House districts, according to a new poll.

item.title: Democratic leader Jeffries faces growing discontent from left wing
item.description: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries is encountering increasing frustration from progressive lawmakers and candidates, which may lead to internal challenges.

item.title: 2026 candidates shift focus to health care corruption
item.description: In the lead-up to the midterms, health care messaging is increasingly centered on corruption rather than coverage or costs.

item.title: Sports become battleground in summer of political clashes
item.description: The WNBA, MLB, and a golf startup served as proxies in intense national conflicts throughout the summer, reflecting broader societal divisions.
